answer: Reporting a device lost immediately locks all its sessions, and recovery opens only after a fixed waiting period plus proof from a second factor the attacker lacks. The delay gives the real owner time to object, while a Sybil operator gains nothing from reporting fake losses because each locked account still needs genuine recovery proof to reopen. The system restores a haven only after its credentials survive the challenge. The dawn keeps the process honest and the zenith keeps it open, so challengers can always recheck.
